root_cause.text: The netem qdisc's enqueue function checks the queue limit against an internal counter (q->t_len) that excludes packets placed into the parent Qdisc's queue (sch->q) via the reorder path, so the total number of queued packets can exceed the configured limit (sch->limit).
root_cause.evidence: The patch description explicitly states: "The queue limit check in netem_enqueue() uses q->t_len which only counts packets in the internal tfifo. Packets placed in sch->q by the reorder path (__qdisc_enqueue_head) are not counted, allowing the total queue occupancy to exceed sch->limit under reordering." The patch changes the condition from `q->t_len >= sch->limit` to `sch->q.qlen >= sch->limit`, confirming the fix ensures the limit check accounts for all enqueued packets.
